main_text.p: [Syriac] Argentum vestrum æruginem cötraxit sibi, id est corruptum est, Jac.5.3.
[Syriac] Syr. Corruptio, Ærugo, Ibid. Sic Chald.
[Hebrew] Ch. Fossa, fovea, Jobi 17.14. & 9.13. Vide & in [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Ch. Manica, Sinus, Respondet Hebraeo [Hebrew] Prover.19.24. & 26.15.
[Hebrew] Ch. Farrago, ut in Regiis translatum est, Amos 7.1. pro eo scribitur [Hebrew] in aliis editionibus. Mercerus transfert Fœnum, quem vide in ejus annotationibus, ut & D. Kimchium.
[Hebrew] Chal. & Syr. Stultescere, stultè agere, insanire. Ithpah. [Hebrew] Ch. Stultescere, stultum, amentem insanum se fingere, insanum agere.
[Hebrew] Ch. Stultus, stolidus, insanus, Hinc Gall. Sot.
Plur. emph. [Hebrew], 1.Sam.21.v.ult. Syr. [Syriac], 1. ad Cor.4.10. Fœm. [Hebrew], Eccles.7.5.
[Hebrew] Ch. Stultitia, stoliditas, amentia, insania. Vide quoque supra in [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Ch. Linea, ordo, series, stylus. Plur. [Hebrew]. Vide quoque supra in [Hebrew] & infra in [Hebrew].
[Hebrew] Ch. Expandit, extendit. Ithpah. [Hebrew] Expansus, pronus cecidit, prostravit, incurvavit se.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are printed in Hebrew/Syriac letters; they are represented here only by placeholders where the letters could not be reproduced reliably. The last line of the page is a Hebrew catchword-like word at the foot right.
